title: Premium Economy Upgrade Price — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Tariff clause — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The Premium Economy upgrade price is the fare brand's Premium Economy upgrade fee for the segment, and the Premium Economy upgrade charge is that price rounded to the cent.

## Terms

- **The segment.** The ticket's first unflown segment: the segment whose number is one more than the number of coupons already flown on the ticket.
- **The fare brand's Premium Economy upgrade fee.** The per-segment price for an upgrade into Premium Economy in the ticket's fare brand price list; it does not depend on the segment's length.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Coupons flown on the ticket | Segment priced | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Segment 1 | The fare brand's Premium Economy upgrade fee, to the cent |
| 2 | Segment 3 | The fare brand's Premium Economy upgrade fee, to the cent |

## Worked example (hypothetical figure)

Suppose a fare brand listed an upgrade into Premium Economy at 90 dollars. On a ticket with one flown coupon, the charge for segment 2 is 90.00 dollars.
